name: gh-setup
description: One-time GitHub repo initialization: label SSOT sync, Projects v2 kanban board, docs/ tree scaffold, ADR records, and ai-metrics footer backfill.

interface.longDescription: gh-setup bundles the five skills you run once, when a repo is new, rather than on every commit. label-bootstrap force-syncs the standard label SSOT: ten classification labels plus three alias renames, two pipeline-state labels, three automation-exclusion labels, and three machine (PC) labels, and deletes nothing unless --prune is passed. kanban-bootstrap creates the Projects v2 board, links the repo, replaces the Status options with the six-column workflow, and delegates its label step to label-bootstrap. docs-bootstrap scaffolds the eight-leaf kind-split docs/ tree with a .gitkeep per leaf and one policy README, dry-run by default. adr-bootstrap fills docs/adr/ with a rules README and template, numbers new ADRs as highest + 1, records supersession with one line in the old ADR, and audits with --check, dry-run by default. add-ai-metrics retrofits the ai-metrics footer onto Issues and PRs created before capture was automatic, idempotently and byte-identically outside the footer block. The GitHub-facing skills need an authenticated gh CLI; kanban-bootstrap additionally needs the project token scope.
defaultPrompt: Bootstrap this new repo's labels and kanban board.
Scaffold the standard docs tree here.
